question: Quorum in a parliamentary procedure can be understood as the _______.

options.text: total number of strength of the house
minimum number of strength to run the business of the house
total number of ministers present in Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**minimum number of strength to run the business of the house.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In parliamentary proceedings, **quorum** refers to the **bare minimum of members needed to be present in order for official business to be conducted.**
 
• A quorum is necessary **to guarantee** that decisions made during a parliamentary process are **valid and accurately reflect the opinions of the members.**
